mapper.sql: id, contact, nickname, phone, email, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.contact, u.nickname, u.email, u.created_at AS createdAt, u.updated_at AS updatedAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.user_id = u.id) AS orderCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM license l WHERE l.user_id = u.id) AS licenseCount FROM `user` u ORDER BY u.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `user` (contact, nickname, phone, email) VALUES (#{contact}, #{nickname}, #{phone}, #{email})
